title: Lumbar (T12-S1) maximal forward flexion, IMU
condition: healthy, standing, upright to maximal forward flexion

quantity.name: range of flexion
quantity.definition: Primary rotation at maximal voluntary motion relative to relaxed upright; trunk = T1 vs global, pelvis = S1 vs global, lumbar = T12 vs S1, T1-T5, T5-T12, T1-T12 relative rotations; absolute values

source.sample: 22 males; 22 young healthy male students, no recent back/hip/knee complications

protocol.summary: Maximal voluntary primary RoMs in standing measured with 4 inertial sensors.
how_to_use: Apply ~55 deg (SD 12) total T12-S1 flexion at full trunk flexion; per-level split needs another source.

measurement.device: Xsens MTx inertial sensors (4) on T1, T5, T12 and S1 spinous processes
measurement.task: slow (4-5 s) maximal voluntary flexion, extension, left/right lateral bending, left/right axial rotation from relaxed upright, 3 trials

extraction.from: Table 1 (segments; bold primary values) and Table 2 (trunk T1)
extraction.check_notes: Rotated Table 1 re-read at 300 dpi; primary values cross-checked against Table 2 and abstract (all identical). | OK (abstract and Table 1/2: lumbar flexion 55.4 ± 12.4 deg; n=22)

pass_rule.rule: input data – not graded; use for robustness checks
